id, specify_machine_id, procedure_code, machine_id, machine_code, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark,

mapper.delete: update t_specify_machine_list set del_flag='1' where id = #{id}
mapper.update:
merge into t_specify_machine_list a USING (
select #{ITEM.specifyMachineId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} specify_machine_id, #{ITEM.procedureCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} procedure_code, #{ITEM.machineId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} machine_id, #{ITEM.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} machine_code,
#{ITEM.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{ITEM.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{ITEM.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{ITEM.updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{ITEM.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON (a.specify_machine_id = b.specify_machine_id and b.procedure_code = a.procedure_code and b.machine_id = a.machine_id AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.machine_code = b.machine_code, a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a.id, a.specify_machine_id, a.procedure_code, a.machine_id, a.machine_code, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.remark, a.del_flag) values (seq_t_specify_machine_list.NEXTVAL, b.specify_machine_id, b.procedure_code, b.machine_id, b.machine_code, b.create_by, sysdate, b.remark, '0')
